readerCopy.body: The new option can make the old pattern look much less inevitable. When Uranus opposes the South Node, a disruption, unexpected person, different route, or sudden possibility can stand directly across from the way you have always handled something. The contrast may be uncomfortable because the familiar arrangement once gave you predictability. You do not have to destroy the past to choose differently. Let the new information change what you consider possible.
